# fetch all playlists in Spotify library (private + public)
access_token = apis.spotify.login(username='ismill@gmail.com', password=[c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if c['account_name']=='spotify'][0])['access_token']

page_limit = 20
page_index = 0
all_playlists = []
while True:
    res = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page', page_index, 'count', len(res))
    if not res:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(res)
    page_index += 1

print('total playlists', len(all_playlists))
# print first 5
for p in all_playlists[:5]:
    print(p['playlist_id'], p['title'], 'songs', len(p.get('song_ids',[])))

access_token = apis.spotify.login(username='ismill@gmail.com', password=[c['password'] for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if c['account_name']=='spotify'][0])['access_token']

# collect playlist totals
playlist_ids = [128,129,131,130,127,126]
# note: from earlier total 6 playlists; let's fetch their ids from library again to be safe
page_limit=20
page_index=0
all_playlists=[]
while True:
    res = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page', page_index, 'count', len(res))
    if not res:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(res)
    page_index += 1

print('playlist ids', [p['playlist_id'] for p in all_playlists])

from math import isfinite

playlist_totals=[]
for p in all_playlists:
    pid=p['playlist_id']
    title=p['title']
    details = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=access_token)
    songs=details.get('songs',[])
    total_seconds = sum([s.get('duration',0) for s in songs])
    # store also minutes exact
    playlist_totals.append((pid,title,len(songs),total_seconds,total_seconds/60))
    print('pid',pid,'title',title,'songs',len(songs),'total_seconds',total_seconds,'minutes',total_seconds/60)

# find longest by total_seconds
longest=max(playlist_totals, key=lambda x: x[3])
print('longest',longest)
rounded_minutes=round(longest[4])
print('rounded_minutes',rounded_minutes)
